title: Railway RRB Group D Exam City / Admit Card 2026
postName: RRB Group D / Level-1 CBT – CEN 09/2025
vacancyDetails: About 22,195 Level-1 / Group D posts under CEN 09/2025; CBT admit cards released phase-wise for August 2026 exam shifts
qualification: 10th pass / ITI / National Apprenticeship Certificate as per CEN 09/2025
ageLimit: 18 to 36 years (as per RRB Group D notification; category relaxations applicable)
applicationFee: ₹250 (UR/OBC/EWS); ₹0 for SC/ST/PwBD/Female/Transgender (refund rules as per CEN)
documentsRequired: Registration Number and Date of Birth (DD/MM/YYYY); printed e-Call Letter; original photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://rrb.digialm.com or your regional RRB site
2. Open Group D / Level-1 e-Call Letter login
3. Enter Registration Number and DOB password
4. Download admit card for your allotted date and shift
5. Carry printed hall ticket and original photo ID to the centre
shortDescription: Railway RRB Group D Admit Card 2026 out for August CBT (CEN 09/2025). Download hall ticket at rrb.digialm.com using Registration No. and DOB. Exams 3–25 Aug 2026.
content:
The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the Group D / Level-1 Admit Card (e-Call Letter) 2026 for Computer Based Test under CEN 09/2025.

CBT is scheduled across multiple days from about 03 August to 25 August 2026 (in three shifts). Admit cards are issued roughly 3–4 days before each candidate’s exam date. City intimation slips were released earlier for travel planning.

How to download

  • Portal: rrb.digialm.com
  • Login: Registration Number + Date of Birth (DD/MM/YYYY)
  • Print the e-Call Letter and verify name, photo, centre, date and shift

Exam day

  • City slip alone is not valid for entry
  • Carry admit card + original photo ID (Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID, etc.)
  • ~22,195 vacancies; very high competition — follow instructions on the hall ticket
